thread:
lina: saw spike in pod connection resets in westus1b around 09:12 UTC, lots of gRPC streams failing.
ajay: yep, dashboards show increased RST and GRPC error 14 for model-serving pods.
infra-bot: ALERT: conntrack table usage > 95% on node gpu-node-13-westus1b (nf_conntrack: 204800/216000).
sasha: is this SNAT ephemeral ports or conntrack entries? earlier we had conntrack tombstones after prefetch bursts.
ajay: digging: a ton of ESTABLISHED/RELATED conntrack entries to external artifacts S3 endpoints, ephemeral ports 32768-60999 basically exhausted.
kai: suspicious — service mesh keepalives + model prefetch creates many short-lived outbound sockets. RDMA/idle probes on some drivers also open sockets for health checks.
lina: short term mitigation options: bump nf_conntrack_max and conntrack hashsize on affected nodes, or enable conntrackd sweeping. prefer not to just lift limit without fixing root cause.
ajay: quick command I'm going to run on a canary node:
```
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=400000
echo 262144 > /sys/module/nf_conntrack/parameters/hashsize
```
sasha: also plan to reduce sidecar keepalive from 10s -> 60s for model-prefetch path and add connection pooling where possible.
ajay: starting a canary rollout of sidecar keepalive change in westus1b, and will bump conntrack on 2 canary nodes, will watch for 10m.
deploy-bot: canary deploy initiated by ajay: sidecar v1.4.8 -> v1.4.9 in westus1b (10% pods)
infra-bot: post-change metrics: gpu-node-13-westus1b conntrack usage down from 98% -> 67%; evictions fell 60% on that node, cluster avg now 71%.
lina: nice. next steps: add runbook section for conntrack saturation, create alert at 85% and attach diag script that dumps /proc/net/nf_conntrack + ss -s. filing INC-1234 to track long-term fixes :thumbsup:
